column1: Melt 1/2 tbsp butter in a large sauté pan over medium-high heat. Scramble the eggs, then move them to a plate.
Melt another 1 tbsp butter in the pan. Add the carrots, onion, peas, and garlic, season with salt and pepper, and cook about 5 minutes until soft.
Turn the heat to high and melt the remaining 1 1/2 tbsp butter.
Add the chilled rice, green onions, soy sauce, and oyster sauce if using. Stir to combine and fry for about 3 minutes, letting the rice sit between stirs so it crisps.
Stir the eggs back in, then remove from the heat and mix in the sesame oil.
Taste, add more soy sauce if needed, and serve hot.
